reports.title: Deere Reports Net Income of $1.051 Billion for Fourth Quarter, $4.860 Billion for Fiscal Year

guidance.heading: Company Outlook & Summary
section: Net income attributable to Deere & Company for fiscal 2027 is forecasted to be in a range of $4.50 to $5.25 billion. The forecast includes an estimated one-time, non-cash pension settlement charge of $0.25 to $0.40 billion associated with a voluntary lump-sum payment option for certain U.S. salaried retirees.

“As we enter fiscal 2027, we’re seeing early signs of improvement in large agriculture, led by North America,” said May. “Given continued uncertainty in key end markets, our outlook reflects a wider range of outcomes. Even so, we’re well positioned to capture the opportunities ahead by delivering solutions that improve our customers’ productivity and profitability, creating lasting value for our shareholders.”
